Hear what I can do. I can lose one of the three to the smoke, and the heirs will believe it, because people die in fires. I cannot lose two. Two is a hunt, and the hunt ends at my neck. His camp is the hut in the swamp, far west of the town, round the lake by the wet road. I do not say what is in that swamp. I say five men went into it and none came back, so go armed or do not go.
